CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSParseDateTime

Reads a date and time written in the conventions of the current locale and returns a date/time value you can do arithmetic with or format with DateFormat and TimeFormat.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSParseDateTime(date_string)

Parameters

date_string
A date, time, or date and time, for example "12/31/1999 11:59 PM" or "January 1, 2000".

Returns

A date/time value.

Usage

If the string is not a valid date, the function throws an error; test it with LSIsDate first. KoldFusion understands the English (US) conventions only (see SetLocale), so the result is the same as with ParseDateTime.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Tests = "12/31/1999 11:59 PM|January 1, 2000|Feb 29, 2000 8:00 AM">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>String</TH><TH>Date/time value</TH><TH>Day of week</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="S" LIST="#Tests#" DELIMITERS="|">
<CFSET D = LSParseDateTime(S)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>#S#</TD><TD>#D#</TD><TD>#DayOfWeekAsString(DayOfWeek(D))#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
